note: Offers, and the beats that follow them: the same shape as plot.json. 'when' holds an offer's conditions (met_days: days he has met them; visits: days he has been in a place; known: people he has met; since_day: days since day 1; cash_below, cash_min; flags; wardrobe: a garment he still owns; words: a manuscript of that many words; on: one date; owes: a cost he owes and his cash cannot meet; cheques: cheques he holds; days: days of the week). Effects, in a beat or in a choice's yes or no: pay (money to him now, or after_min later, at a place 'at', or at his next sitting of 'write' words), cheque (the same, but a cheque he cannot bank), owe, sell (a garment, and what it fetches where 'at'), schedule (a standing engagement with 'days', or an appointment in_days for a beat that follows), reprice (a debt that stands owed is changed), bank (an account: cheques then clear in three days), commission (work that recurs every N days, one piece asked for at a time). A pay with 'flag' sets that flag when it is paid. 'again_days': a refused offer comes back after that many days. Every offer is made by someone present; every price is simulated.
